opening.argument: The title identifies the video as a parody, and the dialogue plays out as a scripted advertisement for a fictional tech-support service. A purported customer then says the call led to prank calls, reinforcing the comedic skit context rather than establishing a genuine service offer. The presentation uses customer-service language, but the cited material describes no request for payment or private credentials. On this record, the observable facts support a parody, not a deceptive transaction.
